page.content:
Finn, Jake, and BMO — the Tree Fort adventurers.

How Heroes of Ooo connects

  • Character: Finn the Human — Finn is the hero at the center of the Tree Fort trio.
  • Character: Jake the Dog — Jake adventures with Finn as brother and partner.
  • Character: The Lich — The Lich is the extinction Finn and Jake have to stop.
  • Location: Tree Fort — Finn, Jake, and BMO live in the Tree Fort.
  • Character: BMO — BMO lives in the Tree Fort with Finn and Jake.

What is Heroes of Ooo?

The Heroes of Ooo are the Tree Fort trio: Finn the Human, Jake the Dog, and BMO, who answer princess calls and stumble into the world's oldest wars.

Key threads lead to Finn the Human, Jake the Dog, The Lich, Tree Fort and BMO.
